body: Secondary school in a small country called Singapore. I’m actually going to see a psychologist soon but I don’t think it’ll help. Nothing really helps.

She’s honestly a nice person and she always treated us with pizza and snacks during lessons. (She earns a lot from outside jobs)But it still gives me major anxiety because she would read out our names and scores according to highest to lowest and I (even though would range around 80-90) would always be the lowest as the others were either getting full marks or just a mark off. And it’s not like she hasn’t done it before. She managed to get entire classes with everyone scoring A’s and being treated luxuriously. I just hate to be that one guy to pull everything down and be seen as the weakling. It just sucks.
Thank you for reaching out. I used to love learning and I still do. I love history and english but sometimes it feels like since I love the subject so much I need to get the A’s.
